steps.content:
If you have to pick between those two, pick **A - Ottervale Audio**.

The product is the same from both:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**
* **A - Ottervale Audio:** Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio, $129.00, In stock. Free standard shipping, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **B - Brackmoor Sound:** Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound, $129.00, In stock. Free standard shipping, 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)

Specs, shipping - arrives in 3 to 5 business days, returns - 30-day returns, buyer pays return shipping - and stated 1-year limited warranty are identical.

The **only difference is this claim on B's page:**

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

That claim is false.

Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers linked from both listings:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/tzb64z/dealers

says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

So:
1. You would **not** get a full manufacturer warranty from either seller.
2. Seller B is actively misrepresenting itself as authorized to get you to trust the warranty, while Seller A does not make that claim.

Buy from A because it's not lying to you, but ideally buy from neither - if you want the full manufacturer warranty, buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead.
